### Detector evidence

[content-policy.mjs](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/tools/content-policy.mjs:139) searches only for an indented standalone `references:` line. It therefore misses valid flow-form frontmatter such as:

```yaml
sources: {references: [{title: "...", url: "https://..."}]}
```

Focused `rendercheck` passed all 17 files, including frontmatter parsing and rendering.

### Rerun and blocker

The final gate rerun remains unchanged: 17 `source-backed-provenance-uncited` errors. No content was edited because the citations are already valid and the dispatch forbids changing the detector.

**Unresolved blocker:** `content-policy-items` cannot pass until a separately authorized detector correction or non-semantic YAML-format normalization is performed.
